quote_mode_disclosure: Saved historical dataset contains OHLCV candles without Bitget L1 tick bid/ask quotes. Quotes are modeled deterministically as bid = close - 0.10, ask = close + 0.10 ($0.20 spread), and stress-tested under NEXT_BAR_OPEN_BID_ASK and 2x spread/slippage ($0.40 spread, $0.20 slippage).
